sites.downstream: Response content printed to stdout via print(completion.choices[0].message.content)
sites.reason: Free-form text generation ('Say this is a test'). The prompt requests arbitrary prose, and the output is consumed as unstructured printed text. Jev does not generate prose.

options.benefit: No change; no speculative savings. Site produces free-form text which Jev cannot replace.

sites.downstream: Streamed response content printed token-by-token to stdout
sites.reason: Free-form text generation ('How do I output all files in a directory using Python?'). The prompt requests an explanatory how-to answer streamed to stdout. Jev does not generate explanations or code.

options.benefit: No change; no speculative savings. Site produces streamed free-form prose which Jev cannot replace.

sites.downstream: Raw response headers (request_id) and response content printed to stdout
sites.reason: Free-form text generation ('Say this is a test') with raw response header access. The output is consumed as unstructured printed text plus envelope metadata (request_id). Jev does not generate prose. Additionally, the site uses with_raw_response for HTTP-level metadata which has no Jev equivalent.

options.benefit: No change; no speculative savings. Site produces free-form text and accesses HTTP envelope metadata which Jev cannot replace.
